notes.title: Juggle Masters: Krav Maga Edition
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27169947/f43dd19cd1c8df7b94389c9e0770c4c9a7825d31.png[/img]
[i]Featuring our newest [b]"Juggle Masters"[/b] Event!
[i][i]For this edition, we'll be seeing what you can do with the Sacred Scroll "Krav Maga".
[i]This will be a recurring event. The possibilities are endless![/i][/i][/i][/i]

[b]Rules:[/b]
[list]
[*]Only the following Sacred Scroll can be used: [b]Krav Maga[/b]
[*]Your juggle video must clearly show your in game name and user interface to prevent identity fraud.
[*]You may not use hacks or 3rd party programs that enhance your game play, stats, or physics of the game.
[*]You may use any various systems implemented in the training system such as training bot teleportation and modifying the training bot to do various moves.
[*]With that said, you do not have to use training mode. You may use a human player as your juggle subject.
[*]The human player can do things to influence your juggle like preemptively jump to start a juggle combo or attack for "counter-launchers".
[*]Your video must be uploaded either on YouTube or Vimeo.
[*]Your entry must be signed by your in game name in your entry post.
[*]If you change your in game name before the prize distribution, you forfeit in game prizes rewarded.
[*]Participation prize will be graded by effort, but ideally you will prove that you can do more than just a standard juggle combo, such as resetting your juggle combo through various platforms and terrain.
[*]ExoCores may be used to aid your juggle, but must not take away that you must highlight using the scroll itself.
[*]If you have more than one existing forum title, you may have to remove a forum title to make room for the new one.
[list]
[*]If this is the case, we will request for your permission to adjust it in a forum PM.
[/list]
[*]Prizes are not tiered. You will only get the prize in your tier.
[/list]
[b]Prizes:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Grand Prize:[/b] "Krav Maga Master" Forum Title, 2500 RC, and featured on Facebook.
[*][b]2nd & 3rd:[/b] "Juggle Champion" Forum Title, 1500 RC, and featured on Facebook.
[*][b]Participation Prize: [/b]Krav Maga Title (30 Days)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/lQByhcb.png[/img]
[/list]
[b]Event Duration: [/b]May 12, 2022 - June 17, 2022
[b]Community Voting: [/b]To be determined

notes.title: Lunar New Year Festivities
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UFw857H.png[/img]
[i]Happy Lunar New Years![/i]

May the strength of the Ox invigorate you during this new year! A wide variety of festivities bless our Fighters to bless them with luck and fortune. All participants in any of the festivities will be automatically rewarded with 1 "Ox Mask" (7 Days) [b][stackable][/b].

[h1]RC Spenders Event[/h1][list]
[*]2,500 RC - 5x Valentine Chests
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GTFHLh2.png[/img]
[*]5,000 RC - Korean Hairpin (Black) & Korean Hairpin (White)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DX0bR2C.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/k8mYFCn.png[/img]
[*]7,500 RC - Korean Hair (Red) & Korean Hair (Blue)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/YCMopMP.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/aOmXI95.png[/img]
[*]10,000 RC - Hanbok Top (Blue), Hanbok Bottom (Blue), Hanbok Jacket (Blue), Hanbok Skirt (Blue)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/HPiUGJZ.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/QebDBnX.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/JI7eBya.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/GqkvF3S.png[/img]
[/list]
For every 2,500 RC spent, receive a New Year Lucky Bag (on a rotation):[list]
[*]2,500 RC - New Year Lucky Bag #1
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xp8cDQA.png[/img]
[*]5,000 RC - New Year Lucky Bag #2
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QYnNVjs.png[/img]
[*]7,500 RC - New Year Lucky Bag #3
[img]https://i.imgur.com/48uIMdD.png[/img]
[*]10,000 RC - New Year Lucky Bag #4
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5MYN88S.png[/img]
[*]After 10,000 RC the cycle will repeat (#1 for 12,500 RC, #2 for 15,000 RC, #3 for 17,500 RC, etc)
[*]Example - 15,000 RC spent will reward the player with all RC prizes, two [u][b]Bag #1[/b][/u], two [u][b]Bag #2[/b][/u], one [u][b]Bag #3[/b][/u], and one [u][b]Bag #4[/b][/u].
[/list]
[h1]Grand Prizes (Top 3 Spenders)[/h1]

[i]Choose one prize from the following:[/i][list]
[*]In-Game Name Change (1 - 12 characters, American alphabet and/or numbers only).[list]
[*]New IGN must not be an existing IGN, must be an appropriate IGN, and abide by RedFox Games rules.
[*]Players will allow be able to reserve their old IGN onto a different/alternate account should they desire. Proof of possession will be required for the account that the IGN will be reserved on.
[/list]
[*]Kuroko Black Set (M/F) [b][WITH STATS][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KnKWWLK.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/NJsgl29.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/aCIBoSo.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/Eg0GkV1.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/Vknz3RC.png[/img]
[*]Kuroko Red Set (M/F) [b][WITH STATS][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vRUbQW5.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/EysJS7i.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/4CCPJhN.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/DqIq1CG.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/MxHCCiS.png[/img]
[*]Shiroko White Set (M/F)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ycfvs36.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/uH1XE0U.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/nK9kpxr.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/4U3se12.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/CHodLAT.png[/img]
[/list]
[b]Participation Prize:[/b][list]
[*]Ox Mask (7 Days) [b][Must spend at least 2,500 RC][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KNom4eJ.png[/img]
[/list]
[h1]Bonus Carats Event[/h1]
Increase your fortune with an additional 20,000 Carats, for a limited time only! Earning [b]20,000 total Carats[/b] from battle (Battle Modes, Adventure Mode, etc) will bestow you the [u][b]Ox's Blessing[/b][/u].  And if you can't hit the mark, don't worry! Earning [b]10,000 total Carats[/b] from battle will instead bestow you the [u][b]Calf's Blessing[/b][/u], earning an additional 5,000 Carats.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2JDDS9b.png[/img][list]
[*]Carat prizes will be given out as "20,000 Carat Cash" or "5,000 Carat Cash"
[*]"Carats earned" will only count towards Carats earned through battle. Carats earned through Reselling and any non-combat means will not count towards this blessing.
[*]Upon receiving "Ox's Blessing", you will lose "Calf's Blessing". This means you will only get an extra 20,000 Carats, [b]NOT[/b] 25,000 Carats.
[*]Carats will be manually distributed upon event completion.
[*][u][b]PRO TIP[/b][/u] - use Silver British, Black Siam, and any of the Baby Dragons for an added boost.
[/list]
[b]Participation Prize:[/b][list]
[*]Ox Mask (7 Days) [b][Must qualify for Calf's Blessing][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KNom4eJ.png[/img]
[/list]

[*]Gain 500 EXP - Red Envelope
[img]https://i.imgur.com/V89qL2L.png[/img]
[*]Earn 250 Kills & Deaths (combined) in all modes except "Adventure" and "AI" Modes  - Good Luck Mix Chest
[img]https://i.imgur.com/YJgZxyB.png[/img]
[*]Complete at least one, full day (three tasks in one day), get one "Ox Mask (7 Days)" [b][Limit 1][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KNom4eJ.png[/img]
[/list]
[h1]Lunar Festivities Event Duration[/h1][list]
[*]Friday, February 12th, 2021 00:00 PM PST - Friday, February 19th, 2021 23:59 PM PST
[/list]
[h1]Prize Distribution[/h1][list]
[*]3 - 5 business days after event concludes
[/list]

notes.title: [EVENT] Boss Mode Rush: Survival
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/9Tqexkv.png[/img]
Experience the Boss Mode Rush, a challenging trial where you and your team must battle against hordes of monsters while completing the objectives.  Trust us when we say that you will not get it down on your first attempt.  Grab your best gear and speed into the Boss Mode Rush.

[h1]Boss Mode Rush: Survival[/h1]
[b][u]Survival Mode[/u] - Clear the maps (in Hell Mode) without reviving a single time. [/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nOJA4R6.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/7a86hXX.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/BcuSWxp.png[/img]

[b]D-H-ZERO (Hell)[/b]
Prizes - 1 Orichalcon Coupon, Ivory Alchemist (M/F) (30 Days), Chest Key Bundle (Normal)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/lJiYSOD.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/PJcW68z.png[/img]


[b]D-H-08 (Hell)[/b]
Prizes - 1 Orichalcon Coupon, World Cup Winner's Hat (45 Days), Chest Key Bundle (Hard)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/WiegMkD.png[/img]


[b]Dragon's Lair (Hell)[/b]
Prizes - 1 Orichalcon Coupon, Bruce as a Zecurb (45 Days), Chest Key Bundle (Hell)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GyFmcne.png[/img]

[u][b]AND[/b][/u]

[b]Completion Prize*[/b]:  Fighter's Battle Flag
*Can receive prize if valid submission shows completion of all three maps 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/59YJjWk.png[/img]

[h1]Event Duration:[/h1][list]
[*]January 8th, 2021 00:00 PDT - January 31st, 2021 23:59 PDT[/list]

[h1]Prize Distribution:[/h1][list]
[*]3 - 5 business days after the event concludes[/list]

[h1]Battle Flag Upgrades:[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CH3iaeM.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zmI9gpb.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/llaJnsk.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6OLBjB9.png[/img]


[h1]Event Rules:[/h1][list]
[*]Boss Mode must be run in Hell difficulty, unless listed otherwise.
[*]No ExoCores may be used unless stated otherwise.
[*]You may only perform the task with a maximum of 4 players.
[*]Only one submission per team. Make sure to submit all videos into the same post.
[*]The use of a Verda’s Coin or Soulstone to revive yourself and other teammates is not allowed.
[*]At least one player must be alive at the end of each Boss Mode. 
[*]All participating IGNs must be written out on the forum post.
[*]If any glitching, hacking or exploits is used, offenders will be subject to a 30+ day in-game ban and a disqualification from the event.
[*]You must adhere to the RedFox Games’ Terms of Service.
[*]All participants must be active in the challenge.
[*][b]NEW:[/b] Any IGN changes before event prizes are distributed MUST be mentioned via a Support Ticket AND must be edited on the BMR submission. If you do not receive your prize for having changed your IGN, the prizes will be revoked and not corrected. In short, please let our staff know about the IGN change to make the necessary changes before sending out prizes.
[/list]
[h1]Event Requirements:[/h1][list]
[*]The Boss Mode run must be recorded or streamed and saved in a VOD (or uploaded onto YouTube).
[*]The video must be accessible to the public and will be reviewed by a RedFox Games staff member.
[*]The video must start at room lobby and end after the scoreboard finishes.
[*]The video cannot be edited (must be raw video).
[*]You may not speed up or slow down the video in any way, shape or form.
[*]Your video submission will be posted on this thread. Multiple videos MUST be within the same post to count (multiple posts will be deleted)
[*]Please make sure video submissions are of completed runs; this means that you should check your work before submitting it onto the thread.
[/list]
[h1]Submission and Event Thread Notice:[/h1][list]
[*]Questions, comments, and concerns regarding this event can be directed to a separate thread that will be provided in [url=https://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/boss-mode-rush-questions-and-feedback.49151/]General Discussion.[/url]
[*]Any content posted on this thread that does not specifically pertain to the event will be removed from this thread. (ie "res", "bump", etc.)
[/list]

notes.title: Boss Mode Rush: Mission
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/9Tqexkv.png[/img]

Experience the Boss Mode Rush, a challenging trial where you and your team must battle against hordes of monsters while completing the objectives.  Trust us when we say that you will not get it down on your first attempt.  Grab your best gear and speed into the Boss Mode Rush.

EDIT: Dark Monastery mission has been altered from killing 2 skeletons per game to killing 2 skeletons per game. If you would like to avoid killing skeletons altogether, it will not give you any further prizes however.

=========================

[h1][b]Boss Mode Rush: Mission[/b][/h1]
[u][b]Mission Mode[/b][/u] - Complete the specific mission for each map.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sCSV9Yd.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/Hw9khip.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/ck6843F.png[/img]

[b]Dark Monastery (Hell):[/b] Defeat Sejul without defeating all of the healing skeletons (Max 2 per spawn)
Prizes - 3 Orichalcon, UGC Flame Top [m/f] (45 Days)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/i1tuDF2.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/Ah5hShT.png[/img]

[b]Vladimir’s Castle (Hell):[/b] Clear the entire Boss Mode without falling off the stage once.
Prizes - 4 Orichalcon, Succubus (14 Days)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Hkihw9e.png[/img]

[b]D-H-CORE (Hell): [/b]Clear the Boss Mode in under 400 seconds.
Prizes - 3 Orichalcon, Carrot Cape (45 Days)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Zit6flV.png[/img]

[u][b]AND[/b][/u]

[b]Completion Prize*[/b]:  Fighter's Battle Flag
*Can receive prize if valid submission shows completion of all three maps 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/59YJjWk.png[/img][/size]

[b]Event Duration:[/b] March 13th, 2020 00:00 PDT - April 5th, 2020 23:59 PDT

[b]Prize Distribution:[/b] 3 - 5 business days after the event concludes

[b]Invincible Battle Flag and King's Battle Flag Upgrade: [/b][/size]
If you have two Fighter's Battle Flags, you may send in a ticket to redeem an Invincible Battle Flag. This time around, however, you may also send in a ticket to replace two Invincible Battle Flags for the next tier, King's Battle Flag. Once you have received the upgrade, the previous two flags will be removed from your inventory.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fGWCkei.png[/img]  [img]https://i.imgur.com/lQYBswu.png[/img]

=========================

Players must complete the Boss Modes with a team of up to 4 players total. As stated in the Event Rules, maps must be in Hell Mode, no ExoCores, and no revives of any sorts.  We encourage players to designate one player to be in charge of recording the run(s).  In order to ensure an organized thread, please write out every players' IGN and consolidate all videos into one post. Make sure to read the rules to better understand the event.[/left]

[b]Event Rules:[/b]
[list]
[*]Boss Mode must be run in Hell difficulty.
[*]No ExoCores may be used unless stated otherwise.
[*]You may only perform the task with a maximum of 4 players.
[*]Only one submission per team. Make sure to submit all videos into the same post.
[*]The use of a Verda’s Coin or Soulstone to revive yourself and other teammates is not allowed.
[*]All participating IGNs must be written out on the forum post.
[*]If any glitching, hacking or exploits is used, offenders will be subject to a 30+ day in-game ban and a disqualification from the event.
[*]You must adhere to the RedFox Games’ Terms of Service.
[*]All participants must be active in the challenge.
[/list]
[b]Event Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*]The Boss Mode run must be recorded or streamed and saved in a VOD (or uploaded onto YouTube).
[*]The video must be accessible to the public and will be reviewed by a RedFox Games staff member.
[*]The video must start at room lobby and end after the scoreboard finishes.
[*]The video cannot be edited (must be raw video).
[*]You may not speed up or slow down the video in any way, shape or form.
[*]Your video submission will be posted on this thread. Multiple videos MUST be within the same post to count (multiple posts will be deleted)
[*]Please make sure video submissions are of completed runs; this means that you should check your work before submitting it onto the thread.
[/list]
[b]Submission and Event Thread Notice:[/b]
[list]
[*]Questions, comments, and concerns regarding this event can be directed to a separate thread that will be provided in General Discussion.
[url]http://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/boss-mode-rush-questions-and-feedback.49151/[/url]
[*]Any content posted on this thread that does not specifically pertain to the event will be removed from this thread.  (ie "res", "bump", etc.)
[/list]

notes.title: [EVENT] Boss Mode Rush: Frenzy
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/9Tqexkv.png[/img]

Experience the Boss Mode Rush, a challenging trial where you and your team must battle against hordes of monsters while completing the objectives.  Trust us when we say that you will not get it down on your first attempt.  Grab your best gear and speed into the Boss Mode Rush.

[b]EDIT:[/b] You must complete all stages with the same team members.


[h1]Boss Mode Rush: Frenzy[/h1]
[u][b]Frenzy Mode[/b][/u] - Clear the maps within a certain time limit.

[u]Maps and Times include:[/u]
[b]D-H-14 WAR[/b] in 500 Seconds
[b]D-H-13 (Hell)[/b] in 500 Seconds
[b]D-H-SBase (Hell)[/b] in 500 Seconds
[i](Hint: Timer should be greater that 499 seconds)[/i]

[b]D-H-13[/b]:  2 Orichalcon, MA-Leopard (7 Days)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/NT9kVo4.png[/img]

[b]D-H-SBase:[/b] 2 Orichalcon, Obsidian Soul Fighter (M/F) (30 Days)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/PFNmi6A.png[/img] [img]https://i.imgur.com/5jDxpuJ.png[/img]

[b]D-H-14 WAR:[/b] 2 Orichalcon, Shag Bands (45 Days)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sUUvhyv.png[/img]

[u][b]AND[/b][/u]

[b]Completion Prize*[/b]:  Fighter's Battle Flag
*Can receive prize if valid submission shows completion of all three maps 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/59YJjWk.png[/img]

[b]Event Duration:[/b] January 10th, 2020 18:00 PST - January 31st, 2020 23:59 PST

[b]Prize Distribution:[/b] 3 - 5 business days after the event concludes

[b]Invincible Flag Upgrade Chance: [/b]
Any players that participated in the previous and current Boss Mode Rush events will have 2 Fighter's Battle Flags by the end of this iteration.  Players will now have the option of trading in both Fighter's Battle Flags to receive 1 Invincible Battle Flag. This would mean that both Fighter's Battle Flags will be removed from their account to be replaced with an Invincible Battle Flag.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fGWCkei.png[/img]



Players must complete the Boss Modes with a team of up to 4 players total. As stated in the Event Rules, maps must be in Hell Mode, no ExoCores, and no revives of any sorts.  We encourage players to designate one player to be in charge of recording the run(s).  In order to ensure an organized thread, please write out every players' IGN and consolidate all videos into one post. Make sure to read the rules[/left]

[b]Event Rules:[/b][list]
[*]Boss Mode must be run in Hell difficulty.
[*]No ExoCores may be used unless stated otherwise.
[*]You may only perform the task with a maximum of 4 players.
[*]Only one submission per team. Make sure to submit all videos into the same post.  
[*]The use of a Verda’s Coin or Soulstone to revive yourself and other teammates is not allowed.
[*]All participating IGNs must be written out on the forum post.
[*]If any glitching, hacking or exploits is used, offenders will be subject to a 30+ day in-game ban and a disqualification from the event.
[*]You must adhere to the RedFox Games’ Terms of Service.
[*]All participants must be active in the challenge.
[/list]
[b]Event Requirements:[/b][list]
[*]The Boss Mode run must be recorded or streamed and saved in a VOD (or uploaded onto YouTube).
[*]The video must be accessible to the public and will be reviewed by a RedFox Games staff member.
[*]The video must start at room lobby and end after the scoreboard finishes.
[*]The video cannot be edited (must be raw video).
[*]You may not speed up or slow down the video in any way, shape or form.
[*]Your video submission will be posted on this thread. Multiple videos MUST be within the same post to count (multiple posts will be deleted)
[*]Please make sure video submissions are of completed runs; this means that you should check your work before submitting it onto the thread.
[/list]
[b]Submission and Event Thread Notice:[/b][list]
[*]Questions, comments, and concerns regarding this event can be directed to a separate thread that will be provided in General Discussion.
[url]http://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/boss-mode-rush-questions-and-feedback.49151/[/url]
[*]Any content posted on this thread that does not specifically pertain to the event will be removed from this thread.  (ie "res", "bump", etc.)
[/list]

notes.title: [EVENT] Winter Northern Lights - Enchantment
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/yatIPwQ.png[/img]
[i]A brilliant radiance pierces the Rumble Fighter sky![/i]

[h1]Enchantment Part I[/h1]
As a small incentive for players to enchant successfully to +10, we are giving everyone an opportunity to receive 2 Master Cards every day for one week. All you have to do is simply enchant any Gem from +1 to +5 during the Part I event period. You are limited to 2 Master Cards per day, but you can earn up to 14 cards if you successfully enchant from every day.

[b]Part I Time Slots: [/b]
Enchanting for Part I must take place between these times (server time)[list]
[*]11 AM PST - 1 PM PST
[/list]
[b]Part I Rules:[/b][list]
[*]Gem used for Part I [b]must[/b] start from +1 for each day. It does not matter which gem you use, however. 
[*]Enchanting must happen in the time period mentioned above. 
[*]Zircon of Health must go from +40 to +200. Tanzanite of Mana must go from +12 to +60. 
[*]Enchanting does not need to succeed all at once. As long as your starting point is at +1 and it eventually gets to +5, it will qualify to receive 2 Master Enchant Cards.
[*]you may continually use one gem by downgrading it and upgrading it during this time.
[/list]
[b]Part I Prizes:[/b][list]
[*]2 Master Enchant Cards 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OymuVrW.png[/img]
[*]Daily limit = 2 cards; Total = 14 Master Enchant Cards
[/list]
[b]Event Duration:[/b][list]
[*]December 21st 11:00 PST - December 27th 13:00 PST
[/list]
Prize Distribution:[list]
[*]3 - 5 business days after event concludes
[/list]

[h1]Enchantment Part II[/h1]
[b]Event Rules:[/b][list]
[*]Successfully enchant any level gem to +10 during this event period. 
[*]Enchanting only applies to Ruby of Power (+10), Obsidian of Defense (+10), and Zircon of Health (+400). 
[*]You may only win the main prize once during the event period.
[*]At the end of the event, your gem must remain at +10 or +400. Any changes to it afterwards will result in a disqualification.
[*]GMs will personally send you an email with your prize request list, so please do not send in a ticket requesting your Grand Prize.
[/list]
[b]Grand Prizes (+10 or +400):[/b][list]
[*]Kuroko Black Set (base stats) (M/F)
[*]Kuroko Red Set (base stats) (M/F)
[*]Poseidon Set with Poseidon Spear (does not include ExoCore)
[*]Water Elementalist Set with Poseidon Spear
[*]RedFox Detective Set
[/list]
[b]Event Duration:[/b][list]
[*]December 21th 00:00 PST - January 6th 23:59 PST
[/list]
[b]Prize Distribution:[/b][list]
[*]3 - 5 business days after event concludes
[/list]
For any questions regarding the event, feel free to ask on this thread or over at our Discord.  Good luck on your enchanting. Happy Holidays!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27169947/b5b9927c3f411024d593329ac6a12a2245c31a75.png[/img]

These are the updates for the Item Shop from the September 24th Maintenance.  Head into game to see all the new scrolls that were revamped!

[h1]Items Added to the Item Shop:[/h1]
[list][*]13 Scroll RE Packages (each package contains an RE Scroll and 7 Orichalcon Stones) [b][1700 RC][/b]
[list][*]Judo RE
[*]Combat Sambo RE
[*]Hitman RE
[*]Capoeira RE
[*]Dragon RE
[*]Xinyi Liuhe Quan RE
[*]Eagle Claw RE
[*]Shaolin Tiger RE
[*]Rage RE
[*]Black Tortoise RE
[*]Vermilion Phoenix RE
[*]White Tiger RE
[*]The Blue Dragon RE[/list]
[*]Ascended Sacred Scrolls (34 New Scrolls) [b][1050 RC][/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TZCG6fb.png[/img][/list]
[h1]Ascended Scrolls[/h1][list]
[*]Ascended Scrolls transform your favorite Sacred Scrolls by adding bonus stats on them!
[*]You can either craft or purchase an Ascended Scroll. Purchased scrolls will have an extra [u]HP +80, STR +5, ARM +5, SPD +3, and CRI +20[/u], while upgraded Ascended Lv. 2 Scrolls will only have [u]STR +5 and ARM +5.[/u]
[*]The Ascended Scroll Box now contains an Ascended Tome and an Ascended Jade for all 68 Sacred Scrolls that are available for Ascension.
[*]Additional stat of [b][HP +80][/b] added to Ascended Scrolls purchased in the Shop; not added to Ascended Lv. 2 Scrolls.
[*]Players can access their Ascended Scrolls in the tab called "Enhanced" in the "Skill Item" tab.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BHgZfER.png[/img]
[/list]
[h1]How to Ascend your Sacred Scroll:[/h1][list]
[*]Utilize pre-existing Permanent or Timed Sacred Scrolls plus a matching Ascended Tome or Ascended Jade, which can be attained through the Ascended Scroll Box. These boxes can be attained by completing the 1 Hour Playtime counter found in the "My Info" tab.
[*]Recipe will operate this way (using Vale Tudo as an example)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sDIvBXA.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/acf4c80.png[/img]

[*]Select the Tome or Jade. A notice will come up if you would like to proceed and consume the Tome or Jade.
[*]The Tome or Jade will randomly select a permanent or timed scroll, if you have multiples of the scroll.
[/list]

Here is a complete list of all 68 Sacred Scrolls that are available for Ascension.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FQ3BGkn.png[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/NKwsT7V.png[/img]

notes.content:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/nHjdtC0.jpg[/IMG]
Greetings Fighters!

There will be a server maintenance and patch update happening on Tuesday, July 16th, 2019 @ 6:00PM PDT.

Expected Down Time: 3 Hours


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Complete as of 8:50PM PDT.

During this time, the following changes will be made:
[LIST]
[*]Routine server reset and upkeep
[*]New Game Mode & Event: Hyper Battle!  See below for more details.
[*]Hyper & Classic Mode Skill items are now labeled on the item itself.
[*]Continuing events: [URL]http://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/event-summer-play-time-events-july.47994/[/URL]
[/LIST]
[h1]Skill Item Changes:[/h1]
[B]Fearless (Black):[/B]
[LIST]
[*]New Command K-K-P: Lift up in air.
[*]P-P-P-P: Decrease charging time, unable to block charged last blow.  Increased attack speed.
[*]P-P-K-P: The height of the last blow has been increased.  Additional hits and increased attack speed.
[*]K-K-K-K: Increased attack speed.
[*]Kg: Increased attack speed.  Height of the lifted opponent is increased.
[*]Nanmu Attack: Last attack will be sent over the fence.
[*]Overall damage increase.
[/LIST]

[B]Abyss (Black)[/B]
[LIST]
[*]New Command K-K+G: Stun Command Added, Additional Hits.
[*]P-P-P: Last attack will stun the opponent
[*]K-K-P: Decrease charging time, unable to block the last hit.
[*]Kg:  The time of Invincibility Status has been increased slightly.
[*]Overall damage increase.
[/LIST]

[h1]Sales:[/h1]
[LIST]
[*]New! Hyper Battle Boxes (Scroll & ExoCore): Contains a 1 day version of a sacred scroll or exocore that can be used in the new Hyper Mode!  See below for more details about hyper mode.
[*]Black Friday Box (Red) Re returns!  [Item List]
[*]Mystery Box Red returns!  [Item List]
[/LIST]

[h1]Boss Modes:[/h1]
[LIST]
[*]White Tiger Isle [URL=https://i.imgur.com/v42dTzq.png][Reward List - Click Here][/URL]
[*]D-H-War 14 [URL=https://i.imgur.com/g446hEi.png][Reward List - Click Here][/URL]
[/LIST]

[h1]New Event Mode: Hyper Battle![/h1]
Ever wanted to show your vast arsenal of Sacred Scrolls and ExoCores?  Want to prove that you have the rarest sets, the tankiest builds, and the hardest hitters?  Now is your time to show off your [B]O[/B]ver [B]P[/B]owered items and stats!  Rare items only!

[h1]What is Hyper Battle?[/h1]
Hyper Battle is a mode where you can only use rare items.  For each kill that you get, you will get one additional Battle Coin, however for each death you incur, you will lose one Battle Coin.  You cannot go below 1 Battle Coin.
[LIST]
[*]Hyper Battle will have a ranking system that for now, is not visible to the player.  The more Battle Coins you have, the higher your ranking will be.  If you keep your high ranking, there will be [B]rare and permanent [/B] prizes available to you.  A visible ranking system is still in the works.
[*]Hyper Battle coins will allow you to purchase exclusive items in the future.
[/LIST]

[h1]Rules of Hyper Battle:[/h1]
[LIST]
[*]In order to take a Battle Coin from your opponent, your opponent must have 2 more or Battle Coins in possession.  You may not take their last Battle Coin.
[*]You must [I]Defeat[/I] the your opponent to obtain their Battle Coin.  Knocking off your opponent will not allow you to take their Battle Coin.
[*]Battle Coins can only be obtained by defeating other players in "Hyper Mode".
[*]The amount of Battle Coins you have can be verified in the License tab of your inventory.
[/LIST]

[h1]Hyper Battle Events:[/h1]
[LIST]
[*]Hyper Battle Coin Ranking: The top 3 users with the most Battle Coins will receive a handsome reward that will be both [B]rare and permanent[/B].  More details coming soon.
[*]4 Lucky Players with 6 or more Battle Coins will be randomly selected to receive the "Only Once" Sacred Scroll & ExoCore Box!  More details coming soon.
[/LIST]

notes.title: Demolition Tournament!
notes.content:
[I]A new kind of tournament has arrived.  RedFox Games' first moving screen tournament debuts now![/I]

[h1]Tournament Sign Ups:[/h1]
Click this picture to be sent to the sign up page.
[URL='https://www.playredfox.com/rumble_fighter/tournament_submission'][IMG]https://i.imgur.com/F4IkDl3.png[/IMG][/URL]

[h1]How will I be chosen?[/h1]
Featured Demolition players and invited players will be contacted via e-mail by an official @playredfox.com or rumblefighter@redfox.freshdesk.com e-mail [B]and[/B] forum PM. If you have not been featured, you can increase your chances by:
[LIST]
[*]Increase your in game activity in the next 7 days
[*]Known and vouched as a great team player by the members of the community
[*]Known and vouched for as a great player in general by the members of the community
[/LIST]
The rest will be randomly selected.  [I]There will be 64 participants.

[B]Please make sure to check the e-mail sender.  Make sure it is sent from a @playredfox.com e-mail OR rumblefighter@redfox.freshdesk.com.  If it is neither and they are advertising for an official Rumble Fighter Tournament, please report them for fraud.[/B]
[/I]
[h1]How will I know I have been chosen?[/h1]
You will be e-mailed by an official @playedfox.com or rumblefighter@redfox.freshdesk.com.

[h1]Sign Up Dates:[/h1]
End on February 24th, 2019, 11:59:59 PST

[h1]Sign Up Rules:[/h1]
[LIST=1]
[*]You will only have one chance to submit your in game name.  Make sure it is spelled correctly.
[*]In game name changes before the tournament will result in a forfeit for your slot.
[*][B]YOUR IN GAME NAME MUST MATCH THE ACCOUNT YOU ARE SIGNING UP WITH.  THIS RULE WILL BE STRICTLY ENFORCED.[/B]
[/LIST]
[h1]Tournament Rules:[/h1]
[LIST=1]
[*]Sacred Scroll Ban List: Any scroll that is not in the shop cannot be used.
[*]No ExoCores can be used.
[*]All active pouch item pouch items can be used.
[*]No stat boosting passive pouch items can be used.
[*]Avalon Drivers cannot be used.
[*]Back-Guard items and Rebirth may be used.
[*]Stalling tactics such as excessively running away or constant hit and run tactics will result in a round forfeit (up to the GM discretion).
[*]You may switch scrolls every match (1 match = 3 rounds).  If a round is interrupted by disconnection, need to restart, or any other problem, that specific match will be counted towards scroll switches.  For example: if a round needs to be restarted, that round will still count towards switching scrolls, but will not count towards your winning total.
[*]All matches [B]up to quarter finals[/B] will be [B]first to win 3 rounds[/B].
[*][B]Quarter Finals[/B] will be [B]first to win 5 rounds.[/B]
[*][B]Semi-Finals and and above[/B] will be [B]first to win 9 rounds.[/B]
[*]The only map that will be played will be "Moving Screen: Demolition".
[*]Stat limits:
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]STR, ARM, SPD, JMP must be 30 or below
[*]HP must be 3000 or below
[*]Critical can be used, but only up to 100.
[/LIST]
[h1]General Rules:[/h1]
[LIST=1]
[*]Keep flaming and trash talk to a minimum.  Tilt tactics will not be tolerated under official tournaments.
[*]In game name changes after you have signed up will forfeit any prizes or qualification into the tournament.  Once you receive your prizes, you may change your in game name as usual though.
[*]Cheating in any form will result in automatic disqualification and removal of your prizes on your account, and in some instances may result in a ban.  Cheating is, but not limited to: any form of hacking, having another player log into your account to 1 vs 1 for you, using hacked or exploited item sets or stats.
[*]You may not vouch for yourself.  If you're great at something, they will tell you.
[/LIST]
[h1]Tournament Format:[/h1]
1 vs 1, Single Elimination

notes.title: [EVENT] Halloween Enchantment Event
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/9d64eb1b5db5ff43298632780614483d14ea79c9.png[/img]
[i]Enchantment event is back by popular demand, but this time we're adding more prizes! Will you be lucky enough to reach +10?[/i]

[h1]Event Duration:[/h1]

[b]October 25th 00:00 Pacific - October 30th 11:59 Pacific[/b]

[h1]Enchantment Event will only apply to the following Gems:[/h1][LIST][*]Zircon of Health
[*]Ruby of Power
[*]Obsidian of Defense[/LIST]
[h1]Prizes:[/h1][LIST]
[*]Enchanting a gem to +7 STR/ARM or 280 HP - 1x Orichalcon Stone
[*]Enchanting a gem to +8 STR/ARM or 320 HP - Premium Gem Generator 30 Pack
[*]Enchanting a gem to +9 STR/ARM or 360 HP - One of the following: Orichalcon Scroll Box, Orichalcon ExoCore Box, or 3 Fortune Cards (higher success rate than Master Enchant cards)[/LIST]
[h1]Grand Prize:[/h1] [b][u]Enchanting a gem to +10 STR/ARM or 400 HP, one of the following:[/u][/B]
[LIST]
[*]In Game Name Change (1 - 12 characters, American alphabet and/or numbers only). We will allow you to reserve your old in game name onto a new account if you wish.
[*]RedFox Detective Set
[*]Black Kuroko Set
[*]Dark Phoenix Set (Dark Phoenix Title included)
[*]Poseidon's Set with Poseidon's Spear
[*]Water Elementalist Set with Poseidon's Spear
[*]Blue Dragon Set
[*]Valkyrie Set (Platinum Edition) including Valkyrie Title
[*]Hung Gar
[*]Telos
[*]Fearless
[*][u]Scroll Trade:[/u] If you have 90* days or more of a specific scroll timed, you may redeem it for a permanent version of it. Scrolls that do not have a permanent version that exists cannot be redeemed, such as Sage Master and its variants.
[/LIST]
[i]*Scroll Trade requirement is subject to change.  If the scroll trade requirement is changed, it will be lowered.[/i]

[h1]Rules and Restrictions:[/h1][LIST]
[*]In order for your enchantment to qualify, gems must be enchanted during the event times.
[*]Prizes for each tier can only be redeemed once.
[*]Levels of enchantment can be reached through upgrading and downgrading.
[*]Existing gems levels will not count for prize redemption, meaning if you have a +7 gem prior to this event, it will not count towards the +7 gem prize.
[*]Prizes do not accumulate.  Users must enchant to each individual tier if they want all the prizes.
[*]Prizes cannot be transferred unless specified.
[*]Prizes cannot be forfeited or gifted to another user.
[*]The prize will only go to the account the enchanting was done on.
[*]We will not e-mail you anymore for prize redemption for +9 or 360HP, +10 or 400 HP prizes.  Please send in a help desk to redeem the prize.  Please note, we have a record of all Gem enchantments, so we will be able to determine if you are lying.

notes.content:

Hello everyone, here's what's new at RedFox Rumble Fighter!

Hello everyone, here's what's new at RedFox Rumble Fighter!
Read on to find out what changes are taking place this maintenance.

We are introducing a Level Up Boost Event where all players below Lv. 25, new players, or returning players are able to level up faster up to Lv. 25.

There are also some new RE Scrolls revisions: Vermilion Phoenix RE and Rage RE added (Super Arts Function) Check out the Gameplay Section below for more in-depth details.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/ADNGkt9.png[/IMG]

Vermilion Phoenix RE and Rage RE:[/B][/h1]

[*]Rage RE Package: Contains the Rage RE Scroll + 7 Orichalcon

[*]Vermilion Phoenix RE Package: Contains the Vermilion Phoenix RE Scroll + 7 Orichalcon
[/LIST]

[B]Tempest Package[/B] is now available in the store for a limited time

[B]Metatron – Vermillion Phoenix Box and Packages[/B] are back available on sale for a limited time
[LIST]
[*]South Guardian Metatron Box – Vermillion Phoenix
[*]South Guardian Metatron 5 Package – Vermillion Phoenix
[/LIST]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/e2269c8bbdf12bd80789f475c1c37d5551725566.png[/img]

New user based designed scroll Heartseeker is still available at the store. Congrats to the Scroll Design Winner: @Shana
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/aa3810c7facd70d58b80eafcbdbd36f42ca835cc.png[/img]

Since we have a Summer 1 vs 1 Tournament coming up, we have compiled some New Tournament Packages available at the store with a great discounted prices plus a bonus item.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/7P03m5h.png[/IMG]
[B]July Additional Update: Super Arts RE Scroll List:[/B]
-Vermilion Phoenix RE
-Rage RE
-The Blue Dragon RE
-White Tiger RE

[B]Previous July Game Mechanics Update:[/B]
[h1][B]New Air Forward-Roll Function:[/B][/h1]
Ability to control the posture when being attacked (Mid-air).

[B]Condition Requirements:[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Must have an extra Panic Attack remaining
[*]Click P + K (Panic Attack command) simultaneously while attacked in the mid-air transition of jump and down attack.
[/LIST]

[h1][B]New Gameplay Mechanics Added:[/b][/h1]
[b]Brave Mode:[/B]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/329b2f1867bd78e8bc6fb3f1669b38f6f68b03af.png[/img]
Once your HP start flickering there is an automatic attack boost so you can decide to be brave and risky. You will still need to be skillful at attacking since your health is still 15%, but this will allow you to possibly make a comeback win.
[B]Condition Requirements:[/B]
[LIST]
[*]HP must be lower than 15%
[*]Panic/Dying Condition (HP lower than 15%) – HP will be flickering.
[*]Attack hit will increase (Attack Boost) (Auto active. Regardless of class or level)
[/LIST]
[h1][B]Super Arts Function (The Blue Dragon RE and White Tiger RE Exclusive):[/B][/h1]
Able to cast special attack to inflict great damage without transforming into an ExoCore.
[B]Condition Requirements:[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Must meet the Guardian requirement
[*]Equip a scroll Blue Dragon RE and White Tiger RE to cast Super Arts
[*]Brave Mode (HP lower than 15%)
[*]Can only be used 1x per Round
[*]Hit "B" to execute the Super Arts

Other Fixes:
[*]Scroll-Heartseeker: Attack range of combos is expanded (KKK, KKK+G)
[*]Andro: An issue of unable to heal/recover upon the occurrence of Overheat (while transformed) is fixed
[*]Scroll- Volt: An issue of grab has fixed

[/LIST]
[B]Note:[/B] Brave Mode will end if the Super Arts is being used while HP is lower than 15% (regardless of it being successful or failed attempt)
Super Arts is a Function that the developers are still developing possibly for other scrolls in the future. Let us know what you think of these additional gameplay mechanics and changes.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/58vJEzF.png[/IMG]
Let us know what you think of these gameplay mechanic changes. You can always send us some feedback by sending us a support ticket for full details. Thanks everyone we hope that you like the new game mechanics.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/0pqopyx.png[/IMG]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/bcc067f284588669a80b34a3312ae34e9cc13474.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/789ac529dc27e226f4633aeff3115fc17c830158.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/f46b30c04453a9c7305e36d4870b2a69a6767b27.png[/img]

notes.title: [EVENT] Level Up Boost Event
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/c71c6793cae991388cbe5cddf140be63358243bf.png[/img]

[I]We are introducing a New Level Up Boost Event for all players below Lv. 25, new players, or returning players that wants to level up faster up to Lv. 25. [/I]

[B]Rules: [/B]
[LIST]
[*][B]All players below Lv. 25 are eligible[/B] to a Level Up Boost!
[*]Play 5 Rounds to get 1x LV UP Help Ticket.
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*]Players can receive a total of 5 LV Up Tickets per day
[*]Players can only use Lv UP Tickets one at a time cannot be stacked
[*]Players can use 5 LV UP Tickets per day
[*]Max Level Up Ticket reach is Lv. 25
[*]Players that are already pass Lv. 25 will [B]NOT[/B] be able to use the Lv Up Ticket Boost
[*]Once The Lv UP Help Ticket is obtain you can click it to activate it and your EXP should reach 1 EXP point away to the designated next level
[*]You can literally just do one additional round of game to earn +1 EXP point to get to the next level
[/LIST]
[LIST]
[*][B][B]Example: [/B][/B]Lv.1 (0/500) >> LV UP Ticket >> Lv. 1 (499/500) >> +1 >>Lv.2
[*]All unused LV UP Tickets will be discarded at the end of event. Player must use their LV UP Tickets by the end of the event!
[/LIST]
[B]Event Counters:[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Level UP! UP! UP! Counter: 0/25 (0/120)
[*]Daily Limit: 0/25 Players are able to get 25 Rounds = 5 LV UP Help Ticket per day
[*]Total Overall Rounds (0/120)
[/LIST]
[B]Event Duration:[/B] July 24, 2018 – August 21, 2018 18:00 PST

Note this thread is subject to change.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/329b2f1867bd78e8bc6fb3f1669b38f6f68b03af.png[/img]
Once your HP start flickering there is an automatic attack boost so you can decide to be brave and risky. You will still need to be skillful at attacking since your health is still 15%, but this will allow you to possibly make a comeback win.
[B]Condition Requirements:[/B]
[LIST]
[*]HP must be lower than 15%
[*]Panic/Dying Condition (HP lower than 15%) – HP will be flickering.
[*]Attack hit will increase (Attack Boost) (Auto active. Regardless of class or level)
[/LIST]
[h1][B]Super Arts Function (The Blue Dragon RE and White Tiger RE Exclusive):[/B][/h1]
Able to cast special attack to inflict great damage without transforming into an ExoCore.
[B]Condition Requirements:[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Must meet the Guardian requirement
[*]Equip a scroll Blue Dragon RE and White Tiger RE to cast Super Arts
[*]Brave Mode (HP lower than 15%)
[*]Can only be used 1x per Round
[*]Hit "B" to execute the Super Arts

Other Fixes:
[*]Scroll-Heartseeker: Attack range of combos is expanded (KKK, KKK+G)
[*]Andro: An issue of unable to heal/recover upon the occurrence of Overheat (while transformed) is fixed
[*]Scroll- Volt: An issue of grab has fixed

[/LIST]
[B]Note:[/B] Brave Mode will end if the Super Arts is being used while HP is lower than 15% (regardless of it being successful or failed attempt)
Super Arts is a Function that the developers are still developing possibly for other scrolls in the future. Let us know what you think of these additional gameplay mechanics and changes.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/58vJEzF.png[/IMG]
Let us know what you think of these gameplay mechanic changes. You can always send us some feedback by sending us a support ticket for full details. Thanks everyone we hope that you like the new game mechanics.

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/0pqopyx.png[/IMG]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/0f04f2477eaa5a6fb9e0b216e32a5fafb844f818.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/05462718bdd31f0090b7922ec0b3f9e5100f569d.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/e9481fffac294f20f5f2bca06ec25f53b550427e.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/d264513f223dcfd21e378202c910af365ddb2027.png[/img]

notes.title: [EVENT] Fisticuffs Friday!
notes.content:
[i]Fisticuffs? Is that a new fashion trend?[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/c8eb6e7724ffcdc50787d6cc2c657c55c3a82bb5.png[/img]

[b]Details:[/b]
[*]A GM will randomly join a room!
[*]The person who knocks the GM off the map, or depletes the GM's hp will win the round.
[*]One winner per round.
[*]Each player may only win once per day.
[*]Note: For example, you can only win one prize on Friday, but may participate again next Friday.
[*]If the item equipped is a timed item, it cannot be converted into a permanent version.
[*]GM's outfit will be announced day of event.[/list]

[b]Prizes:[/b]
Winner may select one of the following
[list][*]One piece of the GM's outfit,
[*]The GM's equipped scroll,
[*]One of the GM's equipped ExoCores,
[*]500 RedFox Credits[/list]

[b]Event Period:[/b] Fridays 11:30 AM - 12:30 PM PST

Visit this page to see the upcoming Friday's outfits! http://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/event-fisticuffs-friday.31108/

notes.title: [1/3/2017] What's New?
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27169947/18b620c36b47aa8e803804e49ded04c87a9be614.png[/img]

Hello everyone. 

Maintenance has concluded. Below include some of the changes made.

[b]Game Play[/b]
[list][*]True Battle Mode: We are aware of the Stage Err error message and are investigating the issue.
[*]AI Battle Mode: Difficulty has been slightly decreased.[/list]

[b]Events[/b]
[list][*]Take a Trip to the Frozen Lake - Set Event
[*]A Present for You - Login Event

[*]A Gift for You, New Fighter: Surprise! Everyone who logged in during the event period of November 15 18:00 PDT - January 3 18:00 PST will receive a Winter Event Special Package!
[*]Holiday Exercise: Prizes will be distributed this week.
[*]For Hire - Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer: Prizes will be distributed this week.[/list]

[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
[list][*]Fearless 7-day: There was an issue regarding Fearless being 7-day instead of 30-day in the Christmas Boxes. The developers will resolve this issue during this update. Thank you for your understanding.[/list]


For full details on the update, please visit this link: http://forums.playredfox.com/index.php?threads/1-3-2017-whats-new.30657/
